quests.title: Does the Archaeologist's House Route Still Run?
quests.summary: A resident of Boyne Cottage wants to know if the way to Archaeologist's House is still open, and has not bothered to check.

steps.text: Ask a local in Archaeologist's House about the road.
steps.line: Shut? Never. There was a sheep on it for a week, that's all. Tell them to come on up.
Open! And only a sheep. I'll ring round. Thank you, there's a little something for you.

start.ask: Sure look, someone said the way through to Archaeologist's House is shut. I've a cousin there and I'd like to know. Could you look in?
start.accept: You're a star. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.
